title: finding(tooling): the i18n gate factory half pins two of its four abstention counters, so factoryRowsNoEnKey went 5 to 0 with nothing failing
body:
Found while implementing objectui#8102 (PR objectui#8421). Not ridden in there: that
card's dispatch scoped the work to header prose and said in writing that no assertion is
to be touched, and adding a pin is a different change from correcting a sentence.

## The asymmetry

`scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` keeps two parallel halves of the same class —
the factory walk (objectui#7567) and the declared hand-rolled registry (objectui#7877) —
with parallel counters. Their pin cases in `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts`
are not parallel.

The hand-rolled case, *"and main is measured, not merely green"*, pins all of its
abstentions:

```ts
expect(counters.handRolledRowsNoEnKey).toBe(0);
expect(counters.handRolledUnjudgedRows).toBe(0);
expect(counters.handRolledUnreadableRows).toBe(0);
expect(counters.handRolledMatchingRows).toBe(counters.handRolledComparedRows);
```

The factory case, *"main carries no factory drift, over a surface big enough for that to
mean something"*, pins two of four and neither of the equalities:

```ts
expect(counters.factoryTables).toBeGreaterThan(25);
expect(counters.factoryComparedRows).toBeGreaterThan(500);
expect(counters.factoryUnreadableTables).toBe(0);
expect(counters.factoryUnreadableRows).toBe(0);
```

`factoryRowsNoEnKey` and `factoryUnjudgedRows` are asserted by nothing, and
`factoryMatchingRows === factoryComparedRows` is asserted by nothing.

## Why it is worth a card

This is the mechanism by which objectui#8102 happened rather than a tidiness gap.
`factoryRowsNoEnKey` went 5 to 0 when objectui#7887 retired the `timeline.relative.*`
rows. Nothing in the repository failed. The only carriers of that number were comments,
so the change was recorded in `packages/test-support/src/defaults-table-scan.ts`'s header,
missed in the gate's own header and in the pin file, and stayed wrong for weeks until a
reader happened to re-run the gate.

The hand-rolled half's own comment states the property the factory half does not have:
*"They are zero today, and zero is a READING here only because the compared count above
says the scan had something to judge."* The factory half prints the same abstentions on
every run and holds none of them to anything.

Note the direction matters more here, not less: the factory half is the one whose
population comes from the SOURCE, so it is the half that silently absorbs new tables —
and the half whose blind-spot size therefore moves without anybody choosing to move it.

## Shape

Mirror the hand-rolled case's four lines into the factory case. Cost is the intended one:
a change in the blind-spot size then has to be made deliberately, in a test, instead of
quietly falsifying a comment. objectui#8421 rewrote the prose so it no longer restates
these counts at all; this is the other half — making the counts themselves fail loudly
when they move.

No assignee, per the lane's rules.

Filed by the `domain:devx @ objectui` dev seat while implementing objectui#8102,
session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`.
